tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every view. Cards sit on it as surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, quiz options and any raised container on bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, table headers, code chips and other wells set into surface or bg. Do not put ink-muted text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text such as meta lines, dates and captions, on bg and surface only (4.3:1 on surface-sunken in Light, so never there).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card borders, row dividers. Never the only cue that a control exists.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (inputs, secondary buttons, quiz options). At least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fills, progress bars, avatars and the focus ring. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (4.7:1 Light, 6.1:1 Dark).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, ghost buttons and accent-colored text on bg, surface and accent-soft (4.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected items, info badges and the join code. Text on it is accent-text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct answers and completed states, on bg and surface. Always paired with a word such as Correct or Complete.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Overdue and attention states, on bg and surface. Always paired with a word such as Overdue.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong answers, destructive actions and errors, on bg and surface. Always paired with a word or mark.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing headlines only, once per page. In Arabic use letter-spacing 0 and line height 1.2. Below 640px use display-sm.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per page: the class or course name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Quiz questions, options and announcement text.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, table cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a note or badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon or avatar and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked items in a card; option padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter minimum; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections inside a card group.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top-level section spacing and hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips and code tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, quiz options, join code, announcements.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, progress bars and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest in Light. Dark uses the line border instead.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and inputs; the touch target.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons in dense lists such as the roster.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Student initial circle.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: The phone TabBar's height (52px tabs + 1px border). Pad pages by it and keep sticky action bars above it.
